status: Frozen scientific design only; no validation book acquisition or evaluation release.
scope: Fresh natural-text bounded deployment-quality screen for the concrete adopted eight-operator pilot configuration; not full-routed deployment or universal impossibility. Existing Stage0/1 inconclusive decisions remain unchanged.
primary_adopted_configuration: The same eight operators, using C32/r128 normal unweighted unguarded W8 maps AFTER the single representative FIT refresh in the referenced protocol. All other functions stay source GGUF. B_pilotcanonical is unchanged; D is refit on the same union with fixed PE6/G2 q512 W8 host roles and identity gauges. The old short-synthetic bank is a development seed, not the primary quality or round-failure unit.

data.source: Official PG-19 validation object storage; metadata-only listing already read, no book payload yet. Fresh relative to this candidate fitting, not a claim of no model-pretraining exposure.
data.ranking: SHA256 ASCII pg19-v1/<split>/<decimal_book_id>, ascending raw digest; ties ascending numeric ID
data.download: Only after source/numeric/protocol approval: exact selected16validationobjects, requested pinned generation, verify advertised size and base64MD5 before decoding; preserve original bytes and SHA256. No bulk dataset/HellaSwag payload. If pinned object missing/changed, report acquisition/tooling blocker; do not silently substitute generation/book.
data.book_unit: All16 selected books, no content/loss-based exclusion or replacement.
data.window: Decode UTF-8 strictly; normalize CRLF then remaining CR to LF. Let midpoint=floor(number of Unicode codepoints/2). Find first LF at or after midpoint; start at character after LF, or midpoint if no LF. Use unchanged suffix from that start. Record midpoint/start and suffix SHA256. No paragraph/content search.
data.tokenization: Pinned model-specific native tokenizer on complete suffix, add_special=true, parse_special=false, no chat template. Use first512 IDs. First256 IDs (including native added special tokens) are context; next256 are groundtruth. Tokenize jointly, not separate context/continuation. If less512, retain book as insufficient and whole primary screen inconclusive; no substitute.
data.groundtruth_score: For target token index j=256..511 inclusive, use logits produced at j-1 in that arm's own context, feed actual groundtruth tokens to every arm. Exactly256 scored tokens/book/model/arm. Fixed batch/ubatch128, context1024; all arms same tokens/batching/threads.
data.validation_role: Fresh quality screen after refresh. These 16 PG validation books never supply refresh fitting or selection.

metrics.primary: For each book/model, d_i is the mean 256-token NLL(C_local_pilot_refreshed) minus mean NLL(B_pilotcanonical), in natural logs. The mean of the 16 book deltas is primary Delta; exp(Delta)-1 is relative custom-subset token-PPL change. Compare only within the same model tokenizer; do not call this official full PG-19 word-PPL or compare PPL across tokenizers.
metrics.secondary: B-source quantization transformation loss, C-source total loss, D-B and C-D on same books, token/logit/route/coverage/finite diagnostics. Report source/B/C/D meanNLL and customsubsetPPL, perbook values. Factor is fixed from VALID; no winner selected on PG outcomes.
metrics.nll_arithmetic: Stable float64 logsumexp of actual finiteF32fullvocabulary logits; logitmax first, double exp/sum/log, subtract targetlogit. Align target indices explicitly and require256scores.

uncertainty.unit: Paired book, not tokens; same16 index resamples across both models and all arms.
uncertainty.primary_family: Only two primary C-B Delta endpoints (Deep, OLM), both retained. Secondary descriptive intervals do not drive primaryfailure.
uncertainty.statistic: For each j, dbar_hat_j=mean16bookdelta; for each shared index draw b, Delta_b_j=mean resampled bookdelta. s_j=sampleSD(ddof1) of10000 Delta_b_j. c=empirical95th percentile(linear method) of max_j abs((Delta_b_j-Delta_hat_j)/s_j). Simultaneous approximate bands Delta_hat +/- c*s_j. No silent drop/redraw.
uncertainty.undefined: Any missing book/nonfiniteNLL/zero nonliteralbootstrapSD makes whole primaryfamily inconclusive, never failure. Literal all-arms logit/route/token identity may be reported as sample identity separately; it is not a proof for other books.
uncertainty.scope: 16-book paired bootstrap approximation, no finite-sample theorem; public nonTEST development screen rather than final confirmation.
uncertainty.qualification: These approximate paired-book bands do not guarantee population coverage or automatically immunize inference against an outlier; preserve all per-book deltas and the limited sample/distribution scope.

metrics.exposure: Record actual pilot replacements/hits/fallbacks per operator/arm/book, separately for unscored input positions0..254, scored-predecessor positions255..510 and the unused final input511. Target j uses logits j-1. No replacement exposure plus differing C/B outputs is an instrumentation problem to investigate. Unexposed operators get no individual quality claim; do not extrapolate Delta NLL linearly by exposure.

prospective_decision.reason: An explicit practical2% relative subset-PPL approximation budget for this concrete compilation screen, common to candidate and future competitors. It is a research choice, not a community-wide publication standard; total change versus source also disclosed.
prospective_decision.bounded_configuration_failure: After valid tooling, numerical/copy gates, the single representative TRAIN refresh and complete scoring of all 16 books: if either model has a simultaneous 95% lower C_refreshed-minus-Bpilot NLL band above log(1.02), reject this concrete finite calibrated eight-operator unguarded deployment attempt on the stated book-window distribution. Root and critic must adjudicate scope before advancing the round. An old short-synthetic domain-shift failure does not consume a method round.
prospective_decision.not_implied: Does not refute every guarded/other-rank/retrained/context-bank family, does not turn Stage0/1 inconclusive into significant results, and supplies no latency or universal MoE quality statement.
prospective_decision.otherwise: Upperbands belowmargin support only this partialscreen. Wide/overlappingbands remaininconclusive and Round2continues. Crediblepartialquality requires all-routed quality/resource/latency expansion beforepublication; no automatic success.
prospective_decision.no_adaptation: After reading these 16 PG validation outcomes, do not refit, refresh calibration, or change geometry, maps, guard, gauge, rank, path, prompts, window or threshold. The single preceding TRAIN refresh requires its own frozen protocol. Tooling repairs preserve hypothesis and failed attempts, refreeze source and restart valid runs; tooling failures do not consume opportunities.
